header.name: Fluidworks
header.description: Fluid logistics: cauldrons are tanks, funnels are pipes, dispensers are ports.

settings.text: Cauldrons are tanks, funnels are pipes. A funnel feeds whatever is behind it into the cauldron in front of it; products come out of the bottom of the tank into a container below it.
Bottling Line (glass bottles and water bottles)

settings.name: fluidworks:rain
